# X360 Manager v1.6.3

## Highlights
- **Full app UI translations** — most screens now respect **Settings → App language** (Dashboard, Setup, Settings, Library, Game Config, Help, update banner)
- **Arabic UI** — complete Arabic for all UI strings; RTL layout when Arabic is selected
- **Version bump** — install v1.6.2 first, then this release to test the **auto-update notification**

## Download
Install **X360-Manager-Setup-1.6.3.exe** (Windows 10/11, 64-bit).

## Updates
The app checks GitHub Releases on startup. When v1.6.3 is published, users on v1.6.2 should see an in-app update banner (**Download** → **Restart & install**).

## Setup
1. Close Xenia before launching games from the manager
2. Data folder: `%APPDATA%\x360-manager\`
3. For in-game language: Game Configuration → pick language → **Save** → **Launch**

## Changes since v1.6.2
- Wired translation keys across Settings, Dashboard, Emulator Setup, Help, Game Library, Game Config, UpdateNotifier
- Fixed Arabic typos in game properties / console mode labels
- Expanded translation key set (~120 UI strings)
